description: Synthetic conformance inputs for the free-index contract. Hash and address predicate fixtures do not assert ownership or a spendable preimage. Decoded transactions, blocks, MTP and stage inputs exercise profile logic, not signatures, real blocks, consensus validity or deployment. Only acceptedBlocks affect state; observed orphan/rejected/mempool lists are audit observations.
scriptHashDefinition: RIPEMD160(SHA256(exact serialized locking-script bytes)), displayed in digest-byte order.

scriptHashMappingCases.note: Anyone-can-spend synthetic test script; not a recommendation for funds.

noticeRoundCases.note: The replacement branch is first observed on May 10. Its round already completed in chain history; discovery and provider publication do not affect the result.
Even if first observed on May 10, wall-clock time cannot activate the target without its accepted child.

balanceTraceCases.note: Nonqualifying spends leave old admitted outpoints; qualifying returns admit new outputs. This is a synthetic decoded-effect trace, not a fee-policy or signed-transaction fixture.

balanceTraceSemantics: Stages 0-12 admit qualifying funding across all transaction versions and debit every accepted confirmed spend of admitted outputs. Stages 13+ admit and debit only version-1 transactions with qualifying TXID prefixes. Earlier admissions and debits persist; enhanced views may apply extra validated spends. Current retrieval/history instead applies current-stage version and prefix rules. Replay uses accepted event stages, discarding orphan/mempool effects. Explicit decoded versions and synthetic TXIDs do not assert consensus validity or hash/serialization correspondence.
recoveryRetentionSemantics: 100 accepted descendants is a SHOULD minimum, not an absolute prohibition or a purge instruction. Operators may depart with published policy and risk disclosure. Live promised state and ongoing supported recovery remain mandatory protections; unverified/orphaned anchors cannot authorize a removal decision. Missing restored data requires unavailable until reconstructed.
notation: JSON keys, stages, snapshots, ledger-view names and logical result classifications in these fixtures describe decoded internal test state, not mandatory request/response formats. Conformance concerns required data availability and spend accounting; no new API, metadata fields or status codes are required.
volumeCountSemantics: Synthetic decoded block entries and accepted-tip changes test count units, anchor exclusion, coinbase exclusion, all-version/unfiltered accumulation and reorganization recounting. Observation contexts label counting invariance only; they do not assert a complete calendar/notice/stage trace or consensus-valid transactions. Each observation is recomputed from its accepted ancestry; local caches, mempool and rejected entries have no authority.
